part.text: The current build returns `Page[]` and runs every plugin for every file, while templates are loaded per page. I’ll preserve that API, add an additive `buildSiteWithStats` result for CLI/tests, and store per-page metadata/rendered HTML plus source/template fingerprints in `dist/.ssg-cache.json`; unchanged pages will reuse the cached final page and still participate in index generation.
